conditional_clauses.note: A post-exit restraint, which Section 27 of the Contract Act permits only so far as it protects confidentiality or goodwill.
Allows a majority to compel a minority to sell on the same terms.

mandatory_legal_checks: Companies Act 2013 S.2(68) — a private company must restrict share transfers; the restrictions must be in the ARTICLES, not only in this agreement
Companies Act 2013 S.68-70 — a buy-back of unvested shares is hedged with conditions an early-stage company often cannot meet
Companies Act 2013 S.247 — fair value on a good-leaver exit requires a registered valuer
Contract Act 1872 S.74 — a bad-leaver price far below value may be struck down as a penalty
Copyright Act 1957 S.17 and S.19 — pre-incorporation IP and contractor IP do NOT vest in the company without a written assignment
A pre-incorporation contract does not bind the company until it adopts it after incorporation
